You repair Playwright end-to-end tests whose locators no longer match the page.

The application is known to be working correctly. The page has changed shape — classes, ids,
labels, structure or ordering — and the test needs to address it as it is now.

Rules:
- Reply with the complete corrected spec file in a single ```ts fenced code block, nothing else.
- Keep the test checking the same thing. You may change locators and expected literal values,
  but the repaired test must still fail if the feature it covers stops working.
- Do not delete assertions, weaken them to something trivially true, or replace a specific
  expectation with one that would pass regardless of what the application does.
- Prefer locators that survive cosmetic change: accessible roles and names, labels, and text a
  user can actually see, over generated class names or positional indexes.

If the feature the test exercises is genuinely absent or broken, reply with exactly NO_REPAIR.

This end-to-end test has started failing. The application still works; the page changed. FAILING SPEC (tests/items-left.spec.ts): ```ts import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test'; /** Locator strategy: id + exact text assertion. */ test('the counter reports how many tasks remain', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('/'); await expect(page.locator('#items-left')).toHaveText('2 items left'); await page.getByTestId('task-toggle').first().check(); await expect(page.locator('#items-left')).toHaveText('1 item left'); }); ``` PLAYWRIGHT OUTPUT: ``` Running 1 test using 1 worker x 1 tests\items-left.spec.ts:4:1 › the counter reports how many tasks remain (4.3s) 1) tests\items-left.spec.ts:4:1 › the counter reports how many tasks remain ────────────────────── Error: expect(locator).toHaveText(expected) failed Locator: locator('#items-left') Expected: "2 items left" Received: "2 left" Timeout: 4000ms Call log: - Expect "toHaveText" with timeout 4000ms - waiting for locator('#items-left') 12 × locator resolved to … - unexpected value "2 left" 5 | await page.goto('/'); 6 | > 7 | await expect(page.locator('#items-left')).toHaveText('2 items left'); | ^ 8 | 9 | await page.getByTestId('task-toggle').first().check(); 10 | at D:\Works\ai\competition\assay\tests\items-left.spec.ts:7:45 Error Context: test-results\items-left-the-counter-reports-how-many-tasks-remain\error-context.md 1 failed tests\items-left.spec.ts:4:1 › the counter reports how many tasks remain ─────────────────────── ``` TRIAGE: The page structure differs from the last known-good build, so something the test addresses has moved, been renamed or been reordered. WHAT CHANGED SINCE THE LAST PASSING BUILD (element signatures; - was there, + is there now): ``` + span[0]{class=count} ``` ACCESSIBILITY TREE OF THE CURRENT PAGE: ``` - main: - heading "Taskly" [level=1] - text: 2 left - textbox "What needs doing?" - button "Add" - searchbox "Search tasks" - group "Filter tasks": - button "All" - button "Active" - button "Completed" - list: - listitem: - checkbox "Toggle Write the reproduction guide" - text: Write the reproduction guide - button "Delete" - listitem: - checkbox "Toggle Record the demo video" - text: Record the demo video - button "Delete" - listitem: - checkbox "Toggle Pin the evaluation set" [checked] - text: Pin the evaluation set - button "Delete" - button "Clear completed" ``` RENDERED PAGE HTML: ```html Taskly
